# Preface {-}

Welcome to **Foundations of World Models**.

This book explores the cutting-edge intersection of generative modeling, reinforcement learning, and self-supervised learning to build AI systems that can understand, predict, and plan in complex environments.

Please navigate through the chapters to begin your journey.
